Definition: from G3700; a sight, i.e. (by implication) the eye:--eye.
BiblicalUsage: Omma is the eye, sight itself. Jesus has compassion and touches the eyes of the blind in Matthew 20:34, and they receive sight and follow Him, and in Mark 8:23 He takes the blind man by the hand and spits on his eyes and lays His hands on him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the touch of Jesus opens eyes, and the blind who see follow Him.
RelatedEvents: Jesus Heals Two Blind Men; Jesus Heals a Blind Man at Bethsaida
